'''Chomperwraith''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Thornwisp]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Chomperwraith's massive flower crown finally sprouted, looking like a movie supervillain. [[Zobos]] fear the gaping maw, but fellow Tatari find the shadow it casts to be the safest place of all."

Chomperwraith is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

== Trivia ==
* Chomperwraith and its evolutions were added to the game on 7/29/2026 alongside [[Kaiseroo]] and [[Saberheart]].
